visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up view of a transparent plastic container filled with reddish-pink jerky pieces being shaken rapidly. (2) A hand holds three thick, rectangular slices of glazed pork jerky stacked vertically against a soft pink and white patterned background with Chinese characters. (3) Pieces of the reddish jerky are poured out of a white and gray foil bag onto a plain white ceramic plate under bright studio lighting. (4) A man wearing glasses, a white T-shirt, and a protective face mask stands in front of a yellow retail display wall featuring posters of meat products, gesturing with his hands as he speaks. (5) A hand picks up a single piece of thick jerky from a pile on a white plate, showcasing its glossy, slightly charred surface. (6) More jerky pieces are poured from a yellow branded bag onto the white plate. (7) Close-up view of a piece of jerky being squeezed to show its dense, fibrous texture. (8) Reddish jerky coated with visible chili flakes is poured from a black bag onto a plate. (9) A close-up reveals the spicy jerky with red chili seeds embedded in the meat. (10) A spoon scoops up golden-brown, fluffy pork floss from a bag, showing its light and airy texture. (11) Chopsticks lift a bundle of shredded dried pork fibers. (12) A hand holds a rectangular piece of extremely thin, translucent pork jerky and breaks it in half to demonstrate its brittle, paper-like quality. (13) A hand places a yellow gift box into a white paper shopping bag decorated with a circular 'meat' character logo. (14) Wide view of the interior of a modern transit station (Xinzuoying) with glass doors, digital signs, and commuters walking in the distance. (15) Static wide shot of the 'Jerky Xiao Kai' retail counter inside a shopping mall, featuring display cases filled with various meat snacks.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-arousal male narration begins over a faint plastic rustling sound of a container. No BGM is present initially. (2) Upbeat, bright acoustic guitar BGM enters at 120 BPM. A soft 'pop' sound effect punctuates the start of a new phrase. (3) A distinct crinkling and sliding sound of jerky being poured from a foil bag is audible under the narration. (4) Narration continues with high articulation clarity and rising intonation; BGM guitar strumming remains consistent in the background. (5) A sharp 'whoosh' transition sound occurs as the narrator describes the handmade process. (6) Another audible 'pour' effect as more jerky is emptied from a bag. (7) High-frequency 'crunch' sound effect occurs when the thin jerky slice is broken, creating a sharp transient in the mix. (8) Background ambience shifts slightly to include low-level room tone and distant, muffled public murmurs as the narrator discusses store locations. (9) Audio concludes with a friendly sign-off from the host, with the music fading out alongside a final hard cut.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Introduction -> Product Features -> Varieties -> Gifting -> Location/CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional endorsement for 'Jerky Xiao Kai', a traditional meat snack brand. It aims to showcase the variety, unique textures (such as thick-cut and paper-thin crispy jerky), and gift-ready packaging of their products while providing specific location information at Xinzuoying Station to drive foot traffic.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video features a host visiting the store, showing specific product packaging with brand logos, and providing the full address and promotional store details at the end.
